_pm_rulings_applied: 08.09.26 (from RFP-031 drafting) - CMU wall beam bearing plates are supply-only under this package; installation, layout from control points, and grouting belong to the Masonry Subcontractor under RFP-031. This exhibit does not claim installation, resolving the apparent conflict inside the narrative's own Structural Steel group (line 1 says 'supply and install ... CMU wall beam bearing plates,' line 3 says 'supply only ... masonry wall embeds').

08.06.26 (D - GLOBAL RULE) - Section 05 31 12 'Steel Roof Decking,' cited by the narrative, is absent from the Project Manual. The published Section 05 31 00 Steel Deck is cited in its place, and the narrative's own title 'Steel Decking' is carried as the group header.

08.11.26 (rule 14) - Do not restate the specs and drawings. Of roughly 30 discrete lines across the narrative's five groups, 10 survive as scope items; 14 are already stated in Section 05 12 23, Section 05 21 00, Section 05 31 00, the S0-00/S0-01 general notes, or this Attachment A's own PROJECT SPECIFIC PROVISIONS, and are carried in review appendix Group A instead.

08.11.26 (rule 14, decision group) - Narrative-only obligations that Corona's own proposal explicitly contests in writing (erection layout, hoisting/shoring, third-party inspection cost) are drafted, verified, and moved to review appendix Group B rather than silently dropped to match Corona's exclusions or silently asserted over Corona's written objection.

08.11.26 (rule 14a) - Exhibit B, Basis of GMP, is not referenced. Its scoreboard structural-load assumption (366TL/251LL) and canopy-post assumption are reflected through the drawn scope (S2-10 joist marks read 16K (366/251); AD1.15 details 4/4A) rather than cited to Exhibit B.

08.11.26 (rule 16) - Exclusions start empty. Of the items a steel erector could plausibly claim were excluded, only 'Field and finish painting' passes the test of what this trade would ordinarily assume is included but is not.
08.11.26 (D4) - Supply and install, not Furnish and install.

Carried-sub authority (per CLAUDE.md, corrected 08.07.26) - Contract amount is the GMP-carried value, not the bare base proposal. Corona's base proposal was $145,468; the Procore budget line 05-1000-10000 carries $166,281 with $0.00 delta. The $20,813 difference reconciles exactly, dollar for dollar, to four negotiated homework adds (canopy posts $7,832 + bollards $1,960 + opening bracing $2,237 + remobilization $8,784 = $20,813).

scope_groups.header: Structural Steel - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:
items: Supply and install all structural steel framing, base plates, connection plates, and edge angles as indicated.
Supply only, F.O.B. jobsite, all structural steel embeds, CMU wall bearing plates, and anchor bolts assembled to templates.
Coordinate delivery and layout of embeds and anchor bolts with the Masonry and Concrete Subcontractors.
Supply and install structural support framing, including columns, for the scoreboard.
Coordinate final scoreboard framing size with the scoreboard supplier per the Site Equipment Matrix on sheet A1-20.
Includes canopy column supply and installation at the abandoned Elementary School campus per Alternate 033.01.

scope_groups.header: Steel Bar Joists - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:
items: Supply and install all steel bar joists, including bridging and accessories, as indicated.

scope_groups.header: Steel Decking - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:
items: Supply and install all steel roof decking at the concessions building as indicated, including closures and reinforcement at openings.
Includes reinforcement of vent and mechanical roof deck openings as required for a complete installation.

scope_groups.header: Ornamental & Fabricated Metals - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:
items: Supply only, F.O.B. jobsite, all steel pipe bollards as indicated.
Supply only, F.O.B. jobsite, all steel countertop supports. Coordinate with Finish Carpentry Subcontractor.

cover_sheet.project_name: NCSD - Tonopah HS Sports Field Replacement

_cover_sheet_note: Material procurement and start dates left unset so the cover sheet prints CONFIRM -- they are CORE-internal and no bid document carries them. P&P bond rate is 0 because Corona quoted 2.50% separately (proposal Bond Information block) and it is not in the carried $166,281; the exhibit prints No Bond Included.
_open_pm_items: Countertop supports (Ornamental & Fabricated Metals group) are required by the Scope of Work narrative but do not appear in any of Corona's four priced homework adds that reconcile the $145,468 base to the carried $166,281. Corona's base proposal also broadly excludes 'Miscellaneous and Ornamental Metals' (Standard General Exclusion #4, cover letter item 3.f). This exhibit carries the requirement per the narrative; confirm it is actually priced before the subcontract is issued.

Joist reinforcement for FCU, duct, and piping loads at the concessions roof is unresolved. Corona's 06.01.26-thread correspondence (05.19.26 scope review agenda) states no load beyond the 366TL/251LL shown on S2-10 was called out, and the Engineer of Record has not confirmed whether MEP equipment loads are covered by the 43.7 PSF snow / 17.3 PSF dead load already used to size the joists. No price has been added for this item, and it is not asserted as an inclusion in this exhibit for that reason.

Alternate 033.01 (canopy at the abandoned Elementary School campus) was originally proposed at $53,519 to reinstall salvaged HSS posts with new steel channels, plates, and anchor bolts per AD1.15 details 4 and 4A. The carried buildup instead reflects a $7,832 homework add priced for 'new 3" post columns.' Confirm whether the alternate is now executed as new-post supply rather than salvage reinstallation, and whether the $7,832 figure includes installation labor or is supply only.

Corona's base proposal (05.12.26) explicitly excludes three obligations this exhibit carries from the Scope of Work narrative: steel erection layout (Standard General Exclusion #2), hoisting/shoring/lift-plan (Standard General Exclusion #3), and third-party inspection costs (Standard General Exclusion #8). None of the later homework responses address these. Resolve before issue -- see review_appendix Group A item 7 and Group B items 1-2.

Corona's 05.19.26 scope-review agenda states 'Assume CORE to provide forklift' for offloading -- not addressed anywhere in the Scope of Work narrative, which places all offloading and hoisting equipment with the Subcontractor. Confirm who furnishes it.

No AESS (Architecturally Exposed Structural Steel) was identified on any sheet reviewed (S0-00 through S4-01, A1-20, A9-20, A10-30), though Section 05 12 23 para 1.01.A.6 includes it in the section's scope and both Corona and Adams & Smith reserved the right to exclude it unless specifically shown. Confirm whether any structural steel on this project is designated AESS.

review_appendix._purpose: PM request 08.11.26. Rule 14 strips every obligation the specs and drawings already carry. This lists what was stripped so the PM can put any of it back. Draft only -- build with --final to suppress it.
intro: Rule 14 keeps out of this exhibit anything the Contract Documents already state, so the Subcontract carries one copy of each obligation rather than two that can drift.

Every line below was drafted, verified and then removed on that basis. All of them still bind the Subcontractor through the document named beneath them. Tick any that should be restated in the Scope of Work above.

groups.header: A.  Already stated in the Project Manual or on the Drawings
note: Restating these creates a second, weaker copy of the same obligation.

items.item: Fabricate and erect structural steel in accordance with AISC specifications, including all bolted and welded connections.
Provide welder certifications for all welders employed on structural steel and joist fabrication prior to the start of work.
Submit shop drawings and a setting plan for all embedded items for Engineer approval prior to fabrication.
Shop prime and galvanize structural steel and miscellaneous metals as indicated.
Provide field welding per AISC standards, including grinding, priming, and removal of paint adjacent to field welds.
Clean and field prime all field welds, including welds at roof decking, after completing installation.
Provide all temporary bracing, guying, and shoring necessary to prevent movement or damage during erection, including a lift plan for approval.

Provide protection and repair of adjacent surfaces damaged as a result of this Scope of Work.
